narration: A conference group arrives at a lakeside hotel in Mwanza, and every room has to be ready at once. With Operra, the front desk sees which rooms are clean, who has checked in, and who is still on the way. The whole group is in their rooms before the opening session.

scenes.line: The whole conference arrives at once.
scenes.image: A long, low building of granite and dark timber with deep verandas on the shore of Lake Victoria in the late afternoon, granite boulders rising from calm water, a coach parked on the gravel drive and delegates seen from behind walking in with rolling suitcases. Warm light, cinematic photograph.
A calm hotel corridor with a housekeeping trolley stacked with folded white towels and fresh linen, soft afternoon light, cinematic photograph.
A bright hotel room with a freshly made bed in white linen and a view of Lake Victoria through the window, afternoon light, cinematic photograph.
Delegates seen from behind walking into a bright conference hall with a lake view through tall windows, cheerful, cinematic photograph.
